dependencies.name: BMAD-METHOD
adopted: Scale planning rigor to stakes and preserve explicit assumptions
Distinguish requirements from implementation decisions
Record only architecture decisions that prevent downstream divergence
Implement against ordered acceptance criteria and observed evidence
Gather context, review independently, validate findings, then triage
notImported: BMAD runtime scripts, generated artifacts, agent names, and mandatory ceremony
Python or uv-based customization and memlog tooling

dependencies.name: agency-agents
adopted: Route specialist perspectives by changed surface
Name architectural tradeoffs and protect dependency direction
Keep diffs scoped and surface unrelated work as follow-up
Use deterministic test data, stable selectors, and failure artifacts
Ground review, security, reliability, and documentation claims in evidence
notImported: Arbitrary issue quotas, default failing grades, stack-specific examples, and aspirational metrics

dependencies.name: gbrain
adopted: Thin public routing with detailed procedures loaded only when relevant
Separate durable project knowledge, operational progress, and session context
Search durable decisions before asking the developer to repeat them
Cite sources, expose conflicts and gaps, and preserve exact decision wording
Test a small representative sample before any approved bulk operation
notImported: GBrain installation, server, MCP configuration, automatic capture, or external writes
GBrain-specific schemas, brain directories, scheduled jobs, and runtime commands

dependencies.name: graphify
adopted: Use an existing graph for broad dependency and path questions
Distinguish extracted, inferred, and ambiguous relationships
Cite graph source locations and validate inferred edges against source
Use scoped query, path, and explain operations before broad graph reports
notImported: Graphify installation, Python code, graph generation, hooks, automatic updates, or API-key configuration

dependencies.name: rtk
adopted: Optionally reduce noisy output for supported read-only and validation commands
Treat reported savings as command-output byte reduction rather than total cost reduction
Return to raw output whenever filtering may hide evidence or a command is unsupported
notImported: RTK binary, Rust source, client hooks, global command rewriting, or an always-prefix rule
